# Muse Connector Template (bluman1)

This is NOT a working connector: it is the starter template every connector in the bluman1/muse-connectors collection was built from — SKILL.md skeleton, frontmatter conventions, maturity ladder (Experimental → Draft → Beta → Stable), auth patterns, safety-confirmation rules, and documentation structure. Use it to scaffold your own Muse connector for any API: copy it, fill in the endpoints, follow the safety rules. No third-party service, no API key, nothing to install as a live integration. Draft: the template itself is written from the collection's conventions — Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use. No secrets in the repo.
